purpose: check quickly that a fresh build is stable enough to be worth testing further or deploying
entry_criteria: A build is deployed to the target environment
A short list of critical checks exists
procedure: Confirm the deployed version equals the intended build.
Run the health checks and the shortest path through each critical function: sign in, one read, one write, one integration.
Check logs and error metrics for new errors immediately after deployment.
Record PASS or FAIL per check with timestamps and the build id.
On any failure, stop further testing or deployment and return the build to the team.
Keep the suite under a few minutes so it can run after every deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Version in the environment equals the intended build
No new error class in logs

validation.expect: all smoke tests pass in under the agreed time

failure_modes.mode: Smoke test passes on the old build

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: After deployment to staging, the smoke suite confirms the version, signs in, reads an order, creates a test order and calls the payment stub, all within ninety seconds.
